Dense fitted sections — BLAZING glossy jet-black marble across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID fine gold veins running through every section, with thin white quartz lines tracing the joints, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Everywhere else, including her bust and her round pregnant belly, the black marble is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.

Background: a hexagonal room with floor-to-ceiling mirrors on all six walls and a white mirrored floor, soft white light from above, so that her figure repeats in a ring of identical reflections that recede in six directions like a kaleidoscope, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright soft white light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
